sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-27B-DFlash2-GGUF is a GGUF quantized conversion of a speculative decoding drafter model, not a standalone language model. Built by z-lab, it implements DFlash 2, a block-diffusion architecture designed to accelerate inference when paired with a target model like Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-27B-DFlash2-GGUF: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases ...
sources.snippet: Overview Qwen3.8-27B-DFlash2-GGUF is not a standalone language model but a quantized GGUF conversion of a speculative decoding drafter built by incoai. It implements DFlash 2, a block-diffusion architecture that predicts entire token blocks in a single pass and maintains top-k candidates at each position, using a lightweight selector to trace coherent paths through them.
